_about: Every visual in the collection: the ones the harness can mount and capture (live), and the ones that ship as a build prompt only, with the reason. Drives both the landing gallery and the lookbook. Source prompts live in incoming/visual-prompts.md.

visuals.title: ASCII swirl
visuals.blurb: A soup of text swirls in a vortex, then condenses into your word. CRT scanlines, chromatic fringe, nine figlet faces.

visuals.title: Chromatic glow
visuals.blurb: A word blooming in neon with its colour channels pulled apart, dissolving and reforming through a palette cycle.

visuals.title: Fade motion
visuals.blurb: Two hundred copies of a word stacked almost invisibly, so the fade is real accumulation. Seven palettes that wash between each other.

visuals.title: Kinetic typography
visuals.blurb: A letter cut into a grid of tiles, each slipping on its own wave, so the glyph ripples like water. Duotone with a chromatic split.

visuals.title: The typer
visuals.blurb: A wave runs across the line and each letter flickers through pill, highlight and outline states before it lands. Adjacent letters merge into one bar.

visuals.title: Dotcut
visuals.blurb: A dense lattice of touching circles with the letter cut out as negative space. Six scenes, each with its own per-cell transition.

visuals.title: Tile field
visuals.blurb: A wordmark built from a dense grid of squares, lit by a slow morphing colour wave, with a soft light blob under the cursor.

visuals.title: Blur reveal
visuals.blurb: Vivid panels, one line each, dissolving in through a cloudy noise front while un-blurring into focus.

visuals.title: Blur glow
visuals.blurb: A crisp word inside a real multi-pass bloom, gradient-mapped through a five-stop ramp on light paper. Six palettes.

visuals.title: Liquid chrome
visuals.blurb: Polished metal with a bright/dark horizon reflection that streams as the cursor moves. Eight colour ramps.

visuals.title: Frosted word + cursors
visuals.blurb: A word rendered as frosted glass with labelled collaborator cursors drifting around it, scattering when you approach.

visuals.title: Embroidery
visuals.blurb: Word-shaped patches stitched onto fabric, with satin stitch angles that follow each stroke and a merrowed border bead.

visuals.title: The art of colour depth
visuals.blurb: Ten button materials built from layering alone: glossy, glow, metal, layered, inset, glass, neon, duotone, satin, foil.

visuals.title: Liquid UI
visuals.blurb: Two cards fuse and the corner between them bends inward, like they were poured together. One knob from crisp joint to gooey neck.

visuals.title: Apple's corners
visuals.blurb: A normal rounded corner has a kink where it meets the edge. The squircle eases in. Here they are side by side.

visuals.title: Text reveal
visuals.blurb: Two corner blocks materialising through a cloudy front as wispy tendrils, then clearing the same way.

visuals.title: Aurora CTA
visuals.blurb: Blurred colour bars rise from the floor behind a logotype, a tagline and a glossy pill button. The closing frame.

visuals.title: Realistic emboss
visuals.blurb: A word or SVG pressed into plaster, with bevel, light angle and surface controls. Nine presets from sharp to pillow.

visuals.title: Ransom note
visuals.blurb: Every letter torn from a different magazine and taped down crooked, with seeded jitter you can re-roll.

visuals.title: Word stickers
visuals.blurb: Die-cut vinyl word stickers you can grab and fling, with a border generated by dilating the glyph silhouette.

visuals.title: Design tiles
visuals.blurb: A sentence packed edge to edge as solid colour tiles, flying in with clip-path wipes and re-rolling their swatches.

visuals.title: Badge trail
visuals.blurb: Tiny mono badges of typography terms drop behind the cursor and fade, never overlapping.

visuals.title: Image galaxy
visuals.blurb: A perspective field of small images drifting behind text, parallaxed by depth and wrapping infinitely.

visuals.title: Pixel field
visuals.blurb: Images cycling in and out of chunky pixelation, with a swap that slides, scales and skews.

visuals.title: Ghost reveal
visuals.blurb: A feathered mask slides across an element in any of four directions, so it materialises rather than fades.

visuals.title: Aurora gradients
visuals.blurb: Three background treatments: blurred bars, a bezier mountain, and a colour-dodge dome, each rising into place.

visuals.title: Design-tool chrome
visuals.blurb: The selection frame from a vector editor: marching border, corner handles and a live size badge, wrapping any element.

visuals.title: Hover video pill
visuals.blurb: Pills that open into a moving clip on hover, with the playback rate on a spring so leaving winds down instead of stopping.

visuals.title: Symbols effect
visuals.blurb: Any picture rebuilt from glyph stamps in four hard brightness bands, so it survives as tone and reads as type.

visuals.title: ASCII particle wordmark
visuals.blurb: Flow-field particles caught into the shape of a word, sampled back into a grid of ASCII glyphs that drift and thicken.

visuals.title: Pixel scan
visuals.blurb: A diagonal band sweeps across and assembles a word out of a spray of tiny coloured blocks, then rests as solid text.

visuals.title: Image sphere
visuals.blurb: A cloud of images orbiting an invisible sphere, billboarded to the camera, hazing into the background at the back.

visuals.title: Loot beam
visuals.blurb: An object turning inside a shaft of golden light, ringed with a silhouette outline and rising motes.

visuals.title: Style melt
visuals.blurb: A portrait cycling through art styles and melting back to the untouched photo along a cursor trail of merged blocks.

visuals.title: Pixel fire
visuals.blurb: A pixel fire on a low-res grid that you can shove around with the cursor, healing back as it burns. Simulated, not sprite-sheeted.

visuals.title: Lifeline
visuals.blurb: Milestones on a dashed rail, swept in left to right with a slow-open ease while the track glides to the newest entry. Derived from evilrabbit/lifeline (MIT).
